_doc: Single source of truth for coverage thresholds. See REPO-STANDARDS-SPEC [COVERAGE-THRESHOLDS-JSON] and docs/specs/SPEC.md. Ratchet only — never lower. Each Rust crate, the extension host, and the webview have their own line-coverage floor; every test target `make ci` runs must measure against its entry here ([TEST-SELECTION]: `make test` filters no test by name; only the feature-gated corpus suite is out). The extension host is instrumented at build time rather than through V8: the desktop host writes no V8 profile for extension code (gh #440), so `scripts/extension-coverage.mjs` compiles the counters into the modules and dumps them from inside the host.
